description: Milestone 3 (README Part III), candidate: LidarFit for ITODD obj 12 (cylinder) with the twinchers of the max probe kernel (charts A and B, noise-trained), without the amodal mask (depth and mask_visib only); solver settings as for the connector (fill_visib, fill_target, clamp 1). Paths are relative to this file.

decisions.parameters: p0 -> distance D of the camera from the model origin (BOP depth_range of ITODD test images, mm); p1 -> elevation of the camera above the model XY plane (90 deg - polar angle); p2 -> roll about the optical axis (0: model +Z up in the image, positive counterclockwise); linear maps from [-1, 1]; azimuth fixed (continuous symmetry about Z); |roll| < 90 deg suffices because of the flip symmetry; chart margins 0.3 rad.
decisions.rendered image: square of normalized image coordinates centred on the optical axis, half-side = margin * r / sqrt(D_min^2 - r^2) (r: radius of the bounding sphere about the model origin, 53.85 mm), i.e. 0.0931 (+-5.3 deg, 557 ITODD camera pixels); resolution 512^2 (1.09 camera pixels per pixel); Z depth along the optical axis, 0 where a ray misses; ray casting with NVIDIA Warp on the model mesh (models/, 348 faces).
decisions.probes: 16 x 16 pyramid kernels (half-size = probe spacing = 32 pixels) centred at the centre of mass of the mask, ordered from the centre outward; y in [-0.8, 0.8] for depths D_min - r .. D_max + r, background 0.8; unknown pixels (NaN) are ignored by the kernels.
decisions.real images: virtual camera: the real camera turned by the smallest rotation that puts its optical axis through the centre of mass of the mask; the depth map is resampled into the stencil square of the virtual camera (nearest pixel) and converted to depth along its axis; background outside the mask, unknown (NaN) where occluded (mask but not mask_visib) or without depth; with edge_cases off, masks touching the image border are dismissed.
decisions.charts: each chart: a twincher with its stencil (ranges as in 'stencil', overridden by the chart's own 'stencil' entries); all charts and attempts are solved and the solution with the smallest misfit to the observation (RMS of the y-tone difference on the known pixels of map_avail) is kept.
decisions.stencil centre: centre c: direction of the model origin; the observation is resampled for the stencil camera aimed at c, so that rendering and observation are aligned, and the pose follows from c. centre: 'com_track' (default: c moved so that the centres of mass of the observed silhouette and of the rendering coincide; centre_silhouette 'fused' or 'mask'), 'dist_y' (c refined by a quadratic model of |y_fused - y_curr|^2 on a 3 x 3 grid of step centre_h * side of the square), 'com' (stencil camera through the centre of mass of the mask, pose by matching the centres of mass); edge_cases: pixels outside the image are unknown instead of dismissing the instance.
